# Material Contracts Summary (draft)

*Generated by the firm's drafting tool from the Acme data room as posted on {{dates.data_room_open}}. Not yet verified.*

## 1. Overview

Acme is party to three material contracts and one real property lease. Because the transaction is structured as a reverse triangular merger, Acme remains the contracting party under each agreement, and no contract is assigned. The table below summarizes change-of-control and assignment provisions and whether consent is required.

## 2. Halvorsen Chemie GmbH: Supply Agreement

Sole qualified supplier of API for Acme's three highest-revenue products. Section 14.2 permits Halvorsen to terminate on 90 days' written notice within 180 days after a change of control of Acme. Consent is not required to close, but Halvorsen should be approached about a waiver.

## 3. Unity Health Purchasing Alliance: Group Purchasing Agreement

Sole-source award for Acme products for Unity member hospitals. Section 11.1 prohibits assignment without Unity's consent. Because a reverse triangular merger does not result in an assignment by Acme, the anti-assignment clause does not apply and no Unity consent is required. Section 11.2 requires 30 days' advance notice of a change of control.

## 4. Durham Manufacturing Facility Lease

Lease with Triangle Research Properties LLC. Section 15.2 deems a transfer of more than 50% of Acme's voting stock an assignment. Landlord consent is required and may be withheld in the landlord's sole discretion.

## 5. Other contracts

Wholesaler distribution agreements have not yet been posted. No other material contracts contain change-of-control provisions.

## 6. Summary of required consents

| Counterparty | Consent required? | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Halvorsen Chemie GmbH | No | Termination right; seek waiver |
| Unity Health Purchasing Alliance | No | Notice only |
